# prime-menubar

prime-rs: Menubar component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/menubar) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-menubar) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/menubar.md)

Menubar — port of `p-menubar` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A horizontal menu bar with drop-down submenus. Items are `prime_menu::MenuItem`: the `items` field defines a submenu. The logic
of paths, focus and search is shared with `TieredMenu` (the `prime-tieredmenu` crate); the root level is horizontal: ← → move along
the root, ↓ expands a group. In a narrow window (`breakpoint`) the list collapses into a button. The `start` and `end` slots are rendered at the
edges of the bar.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_menu::MenuItem;
use prime_menubar::Menubar;

let model = vec![MenuItem::new().label("File").items(vec![MenuItem::new().label("New")]), MenuItem::new().label("Quit")];
let html = Owner::new().with(|| view! { <Menubar model=model /> }.to_html());
assert!(html.contains("p-menubar-root-list") && html.contains("role=\"menubar\"") && html.contains("Quit"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-menubar = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["menubar"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
